# Set Up

```{r}
#| include: false
library(googleCloudStorageR)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggnewscale)
library(viridis)
# library(ggincerta)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Define Functions

# Import Data
## Domain

```{r}
#| output: false
circumpolar = st_read("./domain/circumpolar_domain.geojson")
```

## Subregions
Ecoregions from Dinerstein et al. 2017 will be used as our subregions.

```{r}
#| output: false
subregions = st_read("./domain/circumpolar_subregions.geojson")
```

## Training Data

```{r}
train_meta = gcs_get_object(
  "gs://abrupt_thaw/RTS_MODEL_V2/DATA/TRAINING_DATA/metadata.csv"
)
```

## Countries Map

```{r}
world = rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
world = world |>
  st_transform(3413) |>
  st_crop(
    subregions |>
      st_bbox() |>
      st_as_sfc() |>
      st_buffer(dist = 200000) |>
      st_bbox()
  )
```

:::

# Check Training Polygon Counts by Subregion

```{r}
region_train_count = train_meta |>
  summarise(
    RTSCount = n(),
    .by = RegionName
  ) |>
  mutate(
    RTSPercent = RTSCount / sum(RTSCount)
  )
region_train_count
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
ggplot(
  region_train_count,
  aes(x = RegionName, y = RTSCount)
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
ggplot(
  region_train_count,
  aes(x = RegionName, y = RTSPercent)
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
```

```{r}
small_clusters_percent = region_train_count |>
  filter(RTSPercent < 0.1) |>
  summarise(TotalPercentSmallClusters = sum(RTSPercent))
small_clusters_percent
```

# Map Training Data
## Convert metadata to sf

```{r}
train_points = train_meta %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("centroid_lon", "centroid_lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3413) %>%
  bind_cols(st_coordinates(.))

train_bboxes = train_points |>
  st_buffer(dist = 4.77 * 256, endCapStyle = "SQUARE")
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_hex(data = train_points, aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = "Count") +
  # geom_sf(data = train_points, aes(color = TrainClass)) +
  # scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0, 1),
    legend.justification.inside = c(0, 1),
    legend.background = element_blank()
  )
```
